# Global Food Express

> Indo-Pak and Mediterranean grocery with 100% zabiha halal meat. Two stores in Fort Bend County, Texas: Rosenberg (235 Minonite Rd, Ste 120, Rosenberg, TX 77469, (832) 451-6217) and Sugar Land (10560 Synott Rd, Sugar Land, TX 77498, (281) 879-4261).

Global Food Express sells fresh desi and Mediterranean produce, whole spices and boxed masalas (Shan, National, MDH), aged basmati rice, daal and atta, a zabiha halal butcher counter with custom cuts of goat, lamb, beef and chicken, frozen parathas, samosas and kebabs, imported snacks, mithai, baklava, chai, oils, canned goods and household essentials. It serves Rosenberg, Richmond, Sugar Land, Missouri City, Stafford, Katy and the wider Houston metro.

## Facts
- Street spelling is "Minonite Rd" (the real Rosenberg street name).
- All meat sold is zabiha halal. No non-halal meat is sold.
- Store hours: see the locations pages.
